audio.text: A glass panel is being replaced.

Many jellyfish are drifting in a tank.
A tank is being emptied.

Some jellyfish are being fed by a worker.
Many jellyfish are drifting in a tank.

why.en: Many jellyfish drift in a tank, so (C) is correct. No worker is feeding or replacing anything.

Fish are being counted by an inspector.
A lid is being placed on the tank.
The tank is crowded with jellyfish.

why.en: The tank is packed with jellyfish, so (D) is right. No one is working.

audio.text: The jellyfish are being sorted by size.
A net is being used to catch small ones.
A smaller jellyfish is being swallowed by a bigger one.
A large jellyfish is floating among smaller ones.

options: The jellyfish are being sorted by size.
A net is being used to catch small ones.
A smaller jellyfish is being swallowed by a bigger one.
A large jellyfish is floating among smaller ones.

why.vi: Con lớn đang trôi giữa những con nhỏ hơn nên (D) đúng. Không có ai phân loại hay dùng lưới.
why.en: The large jellyfish floats among smaller ones, so (D) is correct. No one is sorting or netting them.

questions.trap: Câu (C) nghe hợp vì có con lớn và con nhỏ, nhưng chúng không ăn nhau trong ảnh.

audio.text: Where is the nearest pharmacy?
Take two tablets.
Across from the post office.
At six o'clock.

why.vi: Where hỏi chỗ; 'Across from the post office' trả lời.
why.en: 'Where' asks for a place, and 'Across from the post office' gives it.

questions.trap: (A) liên quan thuốc nhưng không chỉ chỗ.

audio.text: Who's in charge of the volunteer schedule?
Every other weekend.
Ms. Ortega is.
It's very full.

why.vi: Who hỏi người; Ms. Ortega là người phụ trách.
why.en: 'Who' asks for a person, and Ms. Ortega is one.

questions.trap: (A) lặp lịch nhưng nói tần suất.

audio.text: When will the new exhibit open?
Sometime in April.
In the east wing.
It's open to everyone.

why.vi: When hỏi thời gian; 'Sometime in April' trả lời.
why.en: 'When' asks for a time, and 'Sometime in April' gives it.

questions.trap: (B) là địa điểm.

audio.text: How do I get a parking permit?
Fill out a form at the front desk.
It's a large lot.
Yes, until five.

options: Fill out a form at the front desk.

why.vi: How hỏi cách; 'Fill out a form' là cách xin thẻ.
why.en: 'How' asks for a method, and filling out a form is one.

questions.trap: (B) nói về bãi đỗ xe, không nói cách xin.

audio.text: Why did the tour group arrive late?
Their bus broke down.
On the tour map.
Around eleven.

why.vi: Why hỏi lý do; 'Their bus broke down' giải thích.
why.en: 'Why' asks for a reason, and the broken-down bus explains it.

questions.trap: (C) trả lời When.

audio.text: Do you need help with those boxes?
Thanks, they're heavier than they look.
The help desk is closed.
Boxes are in the van.

options: Thanks, they're heavier than they look.

why.vi: Chấp nhận gián tiếp: cảm ơn và giải thích vì sao cần giúp.
why.en: It accepts indirectly: thanks, plus the reason help is needed.

questions.trap: (B) lặp help nhưng nói về quầy hỗ trợ.

audio.text: Which supplier offered the better price?
It's a better supplier.
Price lists are online.
The one we used last year.

options: The one we used last year.

why.vi: Which hỏi chọn; 'The one we used last year' xác định.
why.en: 'Which' asks for an identification, and 'The one we used last year' gives it.

questions.trap: (B) lặp price nhưng không chọn nhà cung cấp.

audio.text: What do you think of the new logo?
It's on the logo page.
I'd like to see it in color.
Yes, he logged in.

options: I'd like to see it in color.

why.vi: What do you think hỏi ý kiến; 'I'd like to see it in color' là phản hồi chưa hẳn đồng ý.
why.en: 'What do you think' asks for an opinion, and wanting to see color is a cautious reply.

questions.trap: (C) nghe giống logo/logged.

audio.text: Would you like me to book a table for lunch?
Yes, the tablet is new.
Thanks, I already made a reservation.
Lunch was delicious.

options: Thanks, I already made a reservation.

why.vi: Lời đề nghị; 'I already made a reservation' từ chối vì đã làm.
why.en: An offer, and 'I already made a reservation' declines because it is done.

questions.trap: (A) nghe giống table/tablet.

audio.text: Why isn't the jellyfish tank lit up today?
The bulbs are on order.
Light snacks are served.
Yes, it's a big tank.

why.vi: Why hỏi lý do; 'The bulbs are on order' giải thích.
why.en: 'Why' asks for a reason, and the bulbs being on order explains it.

questions.trap: (B) lặp light nhưng nghĩa khác.

audio.text: When should I submit the overtime form?
In the HR office.
It's due before the payroll cut-off.
Yes, overtime is on Friday.

options: It's due before the payroll cut-off.

why.vi: When hỏi thời hạn; 'before the payroll cut-off' trả lời.
why.en: 'When' asks for a deadline, and 'before the payroll cut-off' gives it.

questions.trap: (A) trả lời Where.

audio.text: Where can I charge my phone?
There's an outlet by the pillar.
Yes, it's free of charge.
A phone call for you.

options: There's an outlet by the pillar.

why.vi: Where hỏi chỗ; 'an outlet by the pillar' chỉ chỗ.
why.en: 'Where' asks for a place, and 'an outlet by the pillar' gives one.

questions.trap: (B) lặp charge nhưng nghĩa khác (miễn phí).

audio.text: How come the café is so quiet today?
It's a quiet café.
Half the neighborhood is at the festival.
Yes, at about two.

options: Half the neighborhood is at the festival.

why.vi: How come nghĩa là Why; 'at the festival' là lý do.
why.en: 'How come' means 'why', and the festival is the reason.

questions.trap: (A) lặp quiet nhưng không giải thích.

audio.text: Could you proofread this brochure?
Yes, the brochure is red.
I can look at it after lunch.
Proof of purchase is required.

options: I can look at it after lunch.

why.vi: Lời nhờ; 'I can look at it after lunch' đồng ý.
why.en: A request, and 'I can look at it after lunch' agrees.

questions.trap: (C) nghe giống proofread/proof.

audio.text: Who's responsible for the leaking pipe?
The plumber is on his way.
Building management, I assume.
It's a lead pipe.

options: The plumber is on his way.

why.vi: Who hỏi người chịu trách nhiệm; 'Building management' trả lời.
why.en: 'Who' asks about responsibility, and building management answers.

questions.trap: (A) liên quan ống nước nhưng không nói ai chịu trách nhiệm.

audio.text: Is it all right if I leave a little early?
As long as the report is done.
Early flights are cheaper.
Yes, it's a little late.

options: As long as the report is done.

why.vi: Xin phép; 'As long as the report is done' đồng ý có điều kiện.
why.en: A request for permission, and 'As long as the report is done' grants it with a condition.

questions.trap: (C) lặp little nhưng trái nghĩa.

audio.text: What's the fee for a late return?
It's the fine print.
A return ticket.
Two dollars a day.

why.vi: Fee là phí; 'Two dollars a day' nêu phí trả muộn.
why.en: 'Fee' means a charge, and 'Two dollars a day' states it.

questions.trap: (A) nghe giống fee/fine nhưng không nói số tiền.

audio.text: Why don't we ask the guide to speak a bit slower?
Some visitors are struggling to follow.
It's a slow day.
Yes, a speaker.

options: Some visitors are struggling to follow.

why.vi: Đồng ý gợi ý bằng lý do: một số khách khó theo kịp.
why.en: It supports the suggestion with a reason.

questions.trap: (B) lặp slow nhưng nói về ngày.

audio.text: How long has the tank been out of service?
Since the pump failed last Friday.
Service starts at ten.
It's the longest tank.

options: Since the pump failed last Friday.

why.vi: How long hỏi khoảng thời gian; 'Since the pump failed' trả lời.
why.en: 'How long' asks for a duration, and 'Since the pump failed' gives it.

questions.trap: (B) lặp service nhưng nói giờ bắt đầu.

audio.text: Where do you keep the visitor log?
Visitors sign in daily.
It's at the security desk.
Yes, a log cabin.

why.vi: Where hỏi chỗ; 'at the security desk' trả lời.
why.en: 'Where' asks for a place, and the security desk is one.

questions.trap: (A) lặp visitor nhưng không chỉ chỗ.

audio.text: Wasn't there supposed to be a demonstration this afternoon?
Afternoon is the best time.
It was moved to tomorrow morning.
A supposed expert.

options: It was moved to tomorrow morning.

why.vi: Câu hỏi phủ định; 'moved to tomorrow morning' cho biết thay đổi.
why.en: 'It was moved to tomorrow morning' answers the negative question.

questions.trap: (A) lặp afternoon nhưng không nói gì về buổi trình diễn.

audio.text: I can't believe the shipment is late again.
Maybe we should switch carriers.
I believe in the shipment.
Yes, he's late.

why.vi: Phàn nàn; 'switch carriers' là đề xuất xử lý.
why.en: A complaint, and switching carriers is a sensible response.

questions.trap: (B) lặp believe nhưng không hợp ngữ cảnh.

audio.text: Who should I ask about the school group booking?
The group booked a room.
Yes, school is out.
Whoever is at the front desk can help.

options: Whoever is at the front desk can help.

why.vi: Who hỏi người; 'Whoever is at the front desk' chỉ người trực.
why.en: 'Who' asks for a person, and 'Whoever is at the front desk' points to one.

questions.trap: (A) lặp book/group nhưng nói đã đặt phòng.

audio.text: Would you mind if I borrowed your notes from the meeting?
Yes, the meeting was blue.
The notes were not at all long.
Not at all, they're in the blue folder.

options: The notes were not at all long.
Not at all, they're in the blue folder.

why.vi: 'Would you mind' xin phép; 'Not at all' nghĩa là không phiền, đồng ý.
why.en: 'Would you mind' asks permission, and 'Not at all' agrees.

questions.trap: (B) lặp 'not at all' nhưng nói về độ dài.

audio.text: Do you think the proposal will be approved or sent back for revision?
Approval comes with a stamp.
Yes, it improved a lot.
The board has been asking for details.

options: The board has been asking for details.

why.vi: Trả lời gián tiếp: hội đồng đang đòi chi tiết nên có thể bị trả lại.
why.en: An indirect reply: the board wants details, so revision is likely.

questions.trap: (A) lặp approve nhưng không chọn.

audio.text: Hi, Neil. I just heard that the Hartley account is moving its order up by two weeks.
Two weeks? That's going to strain the warehouse. We're already short on packing staff.
I know. Could we bring in some temporary workers from an agency?
It's an option, though they'd need training, and that takes a couple of days.
Then let's start right away. I'll call the agency and ask for six people by Monday.
And I'll let the client know we'll confirm the date once we see how many we get.

questions.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?

why.vi: Khách hàng muốn đơn hàng sớm hơn hai tuần, tức là đơn gấp.
why.en: The client wants the order earlier, a rush order.

questions.trap: Chưa có gì bị hư hay hủy.

questions.q: What is mentioned as a drawback of hiring temporary workers?

why.vi: Họ phải được đào tạo mất vài ngày.
why.en: Training takes a couple of days.

questions.trap: Chi phí không được đề cập.

questions.q: What will the woman do next?

why.vi: Cô sẽ gọi công ty cung ứng nhân sự.
why.en: She will call the staffing agency.

questions.trap: Anh Neil sẽ báo khách hàng.

audio.text: Hi, Karen. I'm having trouble with the new accounting software. It keeps logging me out.
It did the same to me yesterday. IT told us to clear the browser cache.
I tried that, and it didn't help. Do you think I should reinstall it?
It's a web application, so there's nothing to reinstall. Why not submit a help ticket? They respond within a few hours.
Okay. But I have to send the payroll report before five.
Then use my computer for now. I'm in meetings until three.

questions.q: What is the man’s problem?

why.vi: Phần mềm liên tục đăng xuất anh ra.
why.en: The software keeps logging him out.

questions.trap: Anh không quên mật khẩu.

questions.q: Why does the woman say reinstalling is unnecessary?

why.vi: Đó là ứng dụng web nên không có gì để cài lại.
why.en: A web application runs online and is not installed.

questions.trap: Cô không nói bản cập nhật hôm qua.

questions.q: What does the woman offer?

why.vi: Cô cho anh dùng máy của cô trong lúc chờ.
why.en: She offers her computer for now.

questions.trap: Ticket là cô khuyên anh tự gửi.

audio.text: Good morning. I called a meeting because we've received three complaints about the new cafeteria schedule.
I've heard them too. People say lunch ends too early at one-thirty.
Honestly, that was my decision. We were losing money in the afternoons.
I understand, but employees on the late shift can't get a hot meal.
What if we keep the main counter open until two, and use only the snack bar after that?
That could work. I'd have to check the cost of the extra staff hours.
Please do, and send the numbers to us by Thursday.

questions.q: What is the meeting about?

why.vi: Có phàn nàn về giờ phục vụ mới của căng tin.
why.en: Staff complain about the new cafeteria hours.

questions.trap: Giá thực đơn không được nhắc.

questions.q: Why was the schedule changed?

why.vi: Buổi chiều quán đang lỗ tiền.
why.en: They were losing money in the afternoons.

questions.trap: Điện không được nhắc.

questions.q: What will the second man do?

why.vi: Anh sẽ kiểm tra chi phí giờ làm thêm của nhân viên rồi gửi số liệu.
why.en: He will check the cost, i.e. calculate expenses.

questions.trap: Quầy snack vẫn mở theo đề xuất.

audio.text: Excuse me, I'm looking for a gift for my sister. She just started her first job as a nurse.
Congratulations to her! How much would you like to spend?
Around fifty dollars. Something practical, maybe.
These insulated water bottles are very popular with hospital staff. They keep drinks cold for twenty-four hours.
That's useful. Can you engrave her name on it?
We can, but it takes three days. If you need it sooner, I'd suggest this one, which comes with a free sleeve.
I can wait. I'll take the engraved one.

questions.q: What is the man doing?

why.vi: Anh tìm quà cho em gái mới đi làm.
why.en: He is looking for a gift.

questions.trap: Anh không trả hàng.

options: They keep temperatures for a long time

why.vi: Giữ lạnh 24 giờ, tức là giữ nhiệt lâu.
why.en: Cold for 24 hours means it holds temperature a long time.

questions.trap: Giảm giá không được nhắc.

questions.q: What does the man imply about the engraving?

why.vi: Anh nói anh có thể chờ, nghĩa là chấp nhận việc chậm.
why.en: He can wait, so the delay is acceptable.

questions.trap: Không ai nói về giá khắc tên.

audio.text: Good afternoon, Tidewater Aquarium. This is Mia.

Understandable. Are there any educational materials for the teachers?
Yes, we email a free activity booklet after you book. Lunch can be arranged in our café, or the children can bring their own.

why.en: He wants to book a field trip.

questions.q: What does the woman recommend?

why.vi: Cô khuyên chia nhóm lớn làm hai.
why.en: She suggests splitting the group in two.

questions.trap: Không nói phải trả trước.

why.vi: Cô sẽ kiểm tra lịch và xác nhận qua email.
why.en: She will check the calendar and confirm by email.

why.en: It will be virtual, no longer in person.

why.vi: Anh sẽ tính lại ngay.
why.en: He will recalculate right now.

Eastbrook is outside the limits, I'm afraid. The delivery charge there is twelve dollars.

audio.text: Lisa, I'm looking at the conference room schedule for next week. Who booked the big room on Tuesday morning?

Hmm. My meeting is more urgent, but I don't mind if you use the lounge on the fifth floor.
The lounge can't fit our group of twenty. Could we do it in the afternoon instead?
The room's free after one. I'll update the calendar and tell you when it's done.

questions.q: What problem do the speakers discuss?

why.en: Both booked the same room, a scheduling conflict.

questions.q: The airline apologized for the ____ caused by the flight delay.

why.vi: Sau mạo từ "the" cần danh từ: inconvenience (sự bất tiện).
why.en: A noun follows "the".

questions.trap: Inconvenient là tính từ nên không đứng sau the làm danh từ.

questions.q: Ms. Lee gave a ____ presentation on solar panels.

why.vi: Giữa "a" và danh từ presentation cần tính từ: convincing (thuyết phục).
why.en: An adjective between "a" and the noun.

questions.trap: Conviction là danh từ (niềm tin) nên không đứng trước presentation.

questions.q: The new recruits were ____ trained before meeting customers.

why.vi: Giữa were và trained cần trạng từ: thoroughly (kỹ lưỡng).
why.en: An adverb sits between "were" and "trained".

questions.trap: Throughout giống mặt chữ nhưng là giới từ, nghĩa khác hẳn.

questions.q: The conference ____ in Seoul when the typhoon warning was issued.

why.vi: Hành động đang diễn ra thì có hành động khác xen vào (was issued): quá khứ tiếp diễn.
why.en: An ongoing past action interrupted by another: past continuous.

questions.trap: Takes place là hiện tại, không hợp với mốc quá khứ.

questions.q: Several complaints ____ by the front desk since last week.

why.vi: Khiếu nại là đối tượng được nhận, kèm "since last week": hiện tại hoàn thành bị động.
why.en: Present perfect passive with "since".

questions.trap: Have received cần tân ngữ ngay sau nó.

questions.q: The seminar will start ____ 9:30 A.M. sharp.

why.vi: Giờ cụ thể dùng at.
why.en: Clock times take "at".

questions.trap: "By 9:30" có nghĩa là chậm nhất lúc đó, không phải bắt đầu đúng lúc đó.

questions.q: The airline will ____ a refund to passengers whose flights were canceled.

why.vi: "Issue a refund" là cụm cố định: cấp hoàn tiền.
why.en: "Issue a refund" is the fixed collocation.

questions.trap: Do/take/put không đi với refund.

questions.q: Employees ____ complete the training will receive a certificate.

why.vi: Chỉ người, làm chủ ngữ của "complete": dùng who.
why.en: A person as subject of "complete": "who".

questions.trap: Whom là tân ngữ.

questions.q: The refund will not be processed ____ the receipt is attached.

why.vi: Unless = if not: sẽ không xử lý trừ khi có đính kèm biên lai.
why.en: "Unless" means "if not".

questions.trap: Although/because/whereas làm câu mất nghĩa.

questions.q: Of all the candidates, Ms. Park has the ____ experience.

why.vi: "Of all..." báo hiệu so sánh nhất: the most experience.
why.en: "Of all" signals a superlative.

questions.trap: More dùng so sánh hơn giữa hai đối tượng.

questions.q: The brochure ____ the new tour packages is available at the desk.

why.vi: Tờ rơi mô tả (chủ động), rút gọn that describes thành describing.
why.en: Active reduced clause: "that describes".

questions.trap: Describes là động từ chính thứ hai, làm câu thiếu liên từ.

questions.q: Each of the exhibits ____ labeled in three languages.

why.vi: "Each" đi với động từ số ít: is labeled.
why.en: "Each" takes a singular verb.

questions.trap: Exhibits nhiều ngay trước động từ là bẫy kinh điển.

questions.q: Mr. Hale's ____ to the team was recognized at the annual dinner.

why.vi: Sau sở hữu cách "Mr. Hale's" cần danh từ: contribution (sự đóng góp).
why.en: A noun follows the possessive.

questions.trap: Contributed là V-ed, không làm chủ ngữ sau sở hữu cách.

questions.q: The manager asked Ms. Chen and ____ to review the schedule.

why.vi: Sau "asked" cần đại từ tân ngữ: Ms. Chen and me.
why.en: After "asked" an object pronoun is needed.

questions.trap: "Ms. Chen and I" nghe lịch sự nhưng I chỉ làm chủ ngữ.

questions.q: ____ of the twelve guests complained about the noise.

why.vi: "None of the + danh từ" nghĩa là không ai. Neither chỉ dùng cho hai người.
why.en: "None of the" + plural; "neither" is for two.

questions.trap: No không đi trước "of the".

questions.q: Prices are subject ____ change without notice.

why.vi: "Subject to" là cụm cố định: có thể thay đổi.
why.en: "Subject to" is fixed.

questions.trap: "Subject of" nghĩa là chủ đề của.

questions.q: The software upgrade is designed to ____ system security.

why.vi: Sau "to" cần động từ nguyên mẫu: enhance.
why.en: A base verb follows "to".

questions.trap: Enhancement là danh từ.

questions.q: Please speak into the microphone ____ everyone can hear you.

why.vi: "So that + mệnh đề" chỉ mục đích: để mọi người nghe được.
why.en: "So that" + clause expresses purpose.

questions.trap: "In order" thiếu "to" hoặc that nên không nối được mệnh đề.

questions.q: Mr. Okoye, ____ office is on the third floor, will assist you.

why.vi: Sau chỗ trống là danh từ "office" của Mr. Okoye: whose.
why.en: A noun follows and belongs to Mr. Okoye: "whose".

questions.trap: Who không đi trực tiếp với danh từ.

questions.q: The jellyfish exhibit is almost ____ popular as the shark tank.

why.vi: Cấu trúc so sánh bằng: as + adj + as.
why.en: Equal comparison: "as ... as".

questions.trap: More/than cần đi cùng nhau, không đi với as phía sau.

questions.q: By next June, the museum ____ open for twenty years.

why.vi: "By + mốc tương lai" cần tương lai hoàn thành: will have been.
why.en: "By + future time" needs future perfect.

questions.trap: Has been là hiện tại hoàn thành, thiếu tính tương lai.

questions.q: Guests are kindly ____ to leave their keys at the front desk.

why.vi: Bị động: guests are requested (được đề nghị) to leave.
why.en: Passive: "are requested to".

questions.trap: Requesting nghĩa là khách đi đề nghị người khác.

questions.q: The firm succeeded ____ reducing its delivery times.

why.vi: "Succeed in + V-ing" là cụm cố định: thành công trong việc.
why.en: "Succeed in" + V-ing is fixed.

questions.trap: "Succeed at" cũng có nhưng ít dùng với V-ing trong đề thi.

questions.q: Online booking is a ____ alternative to calling the office.

why.vi: Giữa "a" và danh từ alternative cần tính từ: convenient (tiện lợi).
why.en: An adjective between "a" and the noun.

questions.trap: Convenience là danh từ, "convenience alternative" không phải cụm quen thuộc.

questions.q: Staff must ____ their schedules to the supervisor by Friday.

why.vi: "Submit something to" là cụm quen: nộp cho.
why.en: "Submit to" fits sending a document.

questions.trap: Admit/permit/commit giống hình thức nhưng không hợp nghĩa nộp lịch.

questions.q: Having ____ the report, Ms. Ito sent it to the director.

why.vi: "Having + V3" diễn tả hành động xảy ra trước: having finished.
why.en: "Having + past participle".

questions.trap: Finishing đi không có Having thì không đủ cấu trúc.

questions.q: A number of tourists ____ asked about the late ferry.

why.vi: "A number of + danh từ số nhiều" dùng động từ số nhiều: have asked.
why.en: "A number of" takes a plural verb.

questions.trap: Phân biệt "The number of" (số ít) và "A number of" (số nhiều).

questions.q: Neither the tour guide ____ the driver knew about the road closure.

why.vi: "Neither ... nor" luôn đi cặp với nhau.
why.en: "Neither" pairs with "nor".

questions.trap: "Or" đi với either.

questions.q: We regret to inform you that the position has already been ____.

why.vi: "Fill a position" nghĩa là tuyển đủ người: has been filled.
why.en: "A position is filled" when someone is hired.

questions.trap: Fulfilled nghĩa là đáp ứng yêu cầu, hay lẫn với filled.

questions.q: The results were ____ better than we had predicted.

why.vi: Trước so sánh "better" cần trạng từ: significantly (đáng kể).
why.en: An adverb modifies the comparative "better".

questions.trap: Significant là tính từ, không đứng trước better để bổ nghĩa.

passages.title: Evening tour training
passages.text:
To: All tour guides
From: Seabright Tours
Subject: Evening tour training

Starting next month, Seabright Tours will [1] evening tours of the harbor on Fridays and Saturdays. All guides who wish to lead these tours must attend a training session on October 12. The session will cover safety procedures, [2] procedures, and customer service skills. [3] Guides will also receive a flashlight and a reflective vest. Anyone interested [4] sign up with Ms. Chen no later than October 5.

questions.q: Blank [1]

why.vi: Sau "will" cần động từ nguyên mẫu: "introduce" (bắt đầu giới thiệu tour mới).
why.en: After "will" use the base verb "introduce".

questions.trap: "introduction" là danh từ nên không đi sau "will".

questions.q: Blank [2]

why.vi: Danh từ ghép "emergency procedures" (quy trình khẩn cấp), song song với "safety procedures".
why.en: The noun compound "emergency procedures", parallel to "safety procedures".

questions.trap: "emergent" là tính từ hiếm gặp, ít đi với "procedures".

questions.q: Blank [3]
options: The harbor tours are among our most popular activities.
All equipment will be provided by the company during the training.
Ticket prices for the evening tours are not yet confirmed.
Ms. Chen has been a guide for more than ten years.

why.vi: Câu sau có "also receive a flashlight", nên câu chèn nói công ty cung cấp thiết bị khi tập huấn.
why.en: "Also receive a flashlight" follows a sentence about equipment being provided.

questions.trap: Câu A lặp "tours" nhưng không nối được với "also receive".

questions.q: Blank [4]

why.vi: "Anyone interested should sign up" dùng động từ khiếm khuyết "should" trước động từ nguyên mẫu.
why.en: "Should" is the modal that precedes the base verb "sign up".

questions.trap: "to be" không đứng được trước "sign up" vì thừa động từ.

passages.title: Library extends hours
passages.text:
Library Extends Hours

The Maplewood Public Library will begin [1] its opening hours on Monday, in response to a survey [2] last spring. According to library director Elena Ruiz, most of the 1,200 residents who responded asked for later evening hours. [3] The library will now stay open until 9 P.M. on weekdays. Weekend hours will remain [4].

questions.q: Blank [1]

why.vi: "begin" thường theo sau bởi V-ing hoặc to V; trong các lựa chọn chỉ có "extending".
why.en: "Begin" is followed by an -ing form or "to + verb"; only "extending" fits.

questions.trap: "extension" là danh từ nên không đi sau "begin" làm động từ.

questions.q: Blank [2]

why.vi: "a survey conducted last spring" là phân từ quá khứ bị động: cuộc khảo sát được thực hiện.
why.en: "A survey conducted last spring" is a passive past participle.

questions.trap: "conducting" mang nghĩa chủ động, không hợp vì khảo sát không tự thực hiện.

questions.q: Blank [3]
options: Books may be borrowed for up to three weeks.
The director has worked at the library for ten years.
A new parking lot is under construction behind the building.

why.vi: "Their" chỉ cư dân đã yêu cầu giờ muộn hơn; câu sau cho biết thư viện mở đến 9 giờ.
why.en: "Their" refers to the residents who asked for later hours, and the next sentence confirms the change.

questions.trap: Câu D nghe như tin thư viện nhưng không nối với yêu cầu của cư dân.

questions.q: Blank [4]

why.vi: "remain unchanged" là cụm cố định: giữ nguyên, không đổi.
why.en: "Remain unchanged" is the standard phrase: stays as before.

questions.trap: "unchangeable" nghĩa là không thể thay đổi, nặng hơn và không tự nhiên cho giờ mở cửa.

passages.title: Reservation confirmation
passages.text:
To: Mr. Duarte
From: Lakeview Hotel Reservations
Subject: Your reservation, May 4 to May 7

Dear Mr. Duarte,

Thank you for choosing the Lakeview Hotel for your stay from May 4 to May 7. We have [1] your reservation for a double room with a view of the lake. Check-in begins at 3 P.M.; [2], if you arrive earlier, we will gladly store your luggage at the front desk. [3] The hotel's restaurant offers a complimentary breakfast daily, [4] is served from 6:30 to 10:00 A.M.

We look forward to welcoming you.

questions.q: Blank [1]

why.vi: "have confirmed" là thì hiện tại hoàn thành: đã xác nhận đặt phòng.
why.en: "Have confirmed" is the present perfect: the reservation is confirmed.

questions.trap: "confirmation" là danh từ nên không đi sau "have".

questions.q: Blank [2]

why.vi: Hai ý đối lập: nhận phòng lúc 3 giờ, nhưng đến sớm vẫn gửi hành lý được. Dùng "however".
why.en: The two ideas contrast: check-in is at 3, but early guests can still store luggage. Use "however".

questions.trap: "therefore" chỉ kết quả, không hợp với ý đối lập.

questions.q: Blank [3]
options: Rooms on the upper floors are available at a higher price.
The city's annual lake festival takes place in July.
Several amenities are included in your room rate.
Reservations may be canceled up to 48 hours in advance.

why.vi: Câu sau nêu "complimentary breakfast", một ví dụ của tiện ích đi kèm, nên câu chèn nói về tiện ích có trong giá phòng.
why.en: The next sentence gives a complimentary breakfast as an example, so the missing sentence introduces included amenities.

questions.trap: Câu D nói chính sách hủy nên không dẫn vào bữa sáng miễn phí.

questions.q: Blank [4]

why.vi: Mệnh đề không xác định sau dấu phẩy dùng "which" cho vật ("breakfast").
why.en: A non-restrictive clause after a comma uses "which" for things.

questions.trap: "that" không dùng sau dấu phẩy; "it" làm câu thành lỗi nối câu.

passages.title: Lifting safety training
passages.text:
MEMO
To: Plant employees
From: Safety Committee

The Safety Committee has reviewed last quarter's incident report and found that most accidents occurred [1] employees were carrying heavy boxes without assistance. To reduce such incidents, the company will provide training in proper lifting techniques. [2] Attendance is mandatory for everyone working in the warehouse. Employees who complete the course will receive a certificate, [3] they must present when requesting protective equipment. Anyone [4] questions about the program may contact the committee at extension 214.

questions.q: Blank [1]

why.vi: "when + mệnh đề": tai nạn xảy ra khi nhân viên tự khuân vác. "during" và "because of" là giới từ, không đi trước mệnh đề.
why.en: "When" introduces a clause: accidents occurred when employees carried boxes alone. "During" and "because of" are prepositions.

questions.trap: "whether" nghĩa là "liệu rằng", không chỉ thời điểm.

questions.q: Blank [2]
options: Last quarter's sales figures were higher than expected.
Protective gloves are available in three different sizes.
Sessions will be held in the main conference room every Tuesday in March.
The cafeteria will remain closed until further notice.

why.vi: Câu sau nói "Attendance is mandatory", nên câu chèn nêu lịch buổi tập huấn.
why.en: "Attendance" needs a prior sentence naming the sessions, so the schedule fits.

questions.trap: Câu B nhắc đồ bảo hộ, nghe liên quan an toàn, nhưng không dẫn tới "attendance".

questions.q: Blank [3]

why.vi: "a certificate, which they must present": "which" thay cho "certificate" làm tân ngữ của "present".
why.en: "Which" replaces "certificate" as the object of "present".

questions.trap: "what" không dùng sau danh từ đã có tiền ngữ.

questions.q: Blank [4]

why.vi: "Anyone having questions" là cụm phân từ rút gọn của "who has".
why.en: "Anyone having questions" is a reduced form of "who has questions".

questions.trap: "has" hay bị chọn vì chủ ngữ số ít, nhưng câu đã có động từ chính "may contact".

passages.title: Anniversary sale
passages.text:
PAPERWORKS OFFICE SUPPLY - ANNIVERSARY SALE
Saturday, September 13 and Sunday, September 14 only

* 25% off all printer paper
* Buy two boxes of toner, get a third box at half price
* Free delivery on orders over $75 within the city

Show this flyer in the store or enter code ANNIV25 online. Sale does not include furniture. Store hours: 9:00 A.M. to 8:00 P.M.

questions.q: How long will the sale last?

why.vi: "Saturday, September 13 and Sunday, September 14 only".
why.en: The sale runs for the weekend, two days.

questions.q: Which customer would qualify for free delivery?
options: A city resident ordering $60 of supplies
A city resident ordering $90 of supplies
A customer outside the city ordering $200 of paper

why.vi: Giao hàng miễn phí cho đơn trên $75 trong thành phố: $90 đủ điều kiện.
why.en: Free delivery applies to orders over $75 within the city.

questions.trap: Bàn làm việc là đồ nội thất, bị loại khỏi đợt giảm giá.

passages.title: North lot closure
passages.text:
GREENFIELD PUBLIC LIBRARY - PARKING NOTICE

Due to resurfacing, the north parking lot will be closed from Monday, October 6, to Friday, October 10. The lot will reopen on Saturday.

Visitors may use the south lot or the Elm Street garage. Parking in the garage is free for the first two hours with a validation stamp from the library desk.

We thank you for your patience.

questions.q: Why will the north lot be closed?

why.vi: "Due to resurfacing".
why.en: The notice gives resurfacing as the reason.

questions.q: How can visitors get free parking in the Elm Street garage?

why.vi: "free for the first two hours with a validation stamp from the library desk".
why.en: A validation stamp from the library desk makes the first two hours free.

passages.title: Order confirmation
passages.text:
ORDER CONFIRMATION #70215
Customer: K. Alvarez

Ergonomic chair, black (2 at $149.00)    $298.00
Chair mat (1 at $39.00)                   $39.00
Subtotal                                 $337.00
Shipping (free on orders over $250)        $0.00
Total                                    $337.00

Estimated delivery: October 12 to 15
Returns: accepted within 30 days in original packaging. Return shipping is paid by the customer unless the item is defective.

questions.q: Why is shipping free on this order?
options: It is the customer's first order

why.vi: "Shipping (free on orders over $250)" và đơn hàng là $337.
why.en: The order total of $337 exceeds $250.

questions.q: Who pays for return shipping if a chair is defective?

why.vi: Khách trả phí gửi trả "unless the item is defective", nên hàng lỗi thì bên bán trả.
why.en: The customer pays unless the item is defective, so the seller pays for a defective chair.

passages.title: Printer replacement
passages.text:
To: All third-floor staff
From: Gloria Banks, Office Manager
Subject: Printer replacement
Date: April 14

Dear staff,

The third-floor printer will be replaced on Wednesday. Until then, please send large print jobs to the second-floor printer. The new printer requires a staff badge to release each job. Badges will be set up at the help desk on Thursday.

Thank you,
Gloria Banks

questions.q: Why did Ms. Banks write the e-mail?
options: To change a help desk schedule

why.vi: Câu đầu: máy in tầng ba sẽ được thay vào thứ Tư.
why.en: The first sentence says the printer will be replaced.

questions.q: What will staff need to use the new printer?

why.vi: "requires a staff badge to release each job".
why.en: The new printer requires a staff badge.

passages.title: Kitchen messages
passages.text:
Hana Cole (11:32 A.M.): Chef, the produce supplier called. Tomorrow's tomato delivery will be late.
Marco Bianchi (11:33 A.M.): How late?
Hana Cole (11:34 A.M.): After 2:00 P.M. A truck broke down.
Marco Bianchi (11:36 A.M.): That's after lunch service. We'll have to change the soup special.
Hana Cole (11:37 A.M.): Should I tell the servers?
Marco Bianchi (11:38 A.M.): Not yet. I need to check what we have in the freezer first. I'll let you know by 4.
Hana Cole (11:39 A.M.): Understood. I'll hold off.

questions.q: What is the problem?

why.vi: "Tomorrow's tomato delivery will be late."
why.en: Ms. Cole says the tomato delivery will be late.

questions.q: At 11:39 A.M., what does Ms. Cole mean when she writes, "I'll hold off"?
options: She will wait to tell the servers
She will stop working for now
She will call the supplier again

why.vi: Chef vừa nói "Not yet" khi cô hỏi có báo cho nhân viên phục vụ không; "hold off" là chờ.
why.en: The chef said "Not yet" about telling the servers, so she will wait.

questions.q: What will Chef Bianchi probably do next?

why.vi: Anh nói cần "check what we have in the freezer first".
why.en: He says he needs to check what is in the freezer first.

passages.title: Electric ferries on trial
passages.text:
PORTLAND (April 9) - The city's transit authority will test two electric ferries on the Harbor route beginning in March, officials announced Tuesday. The boats, built by Nordvik Marine, will replace diesel ferries that are now 25 years old.

Each new ferry carries 120 passengers and can travel 40 kilometers on a single charge. Crews will recharge the boats at the terminal during breaks. Fares will stay at $4 per trip during the six-month trial.

"We expect noise and fuel costs to fall significantly," said transit director Alan Reeve. If the trial is successful, the authority will order four more boats, funded by a state environmental grant.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?

why.vi: Cả bài nói về việc thử nghiệm hai phà chạy điện.
why.en: The article reports a trial of two electric ferries.

questions.q: What will happen to fares during the trial?
options: They will be reduced by half

why.vi: "Fares will stay at $4 per trip".
why.en: Fares will stay at $4 per trip.

questions.q: What is implied about the electric ferries?
options: They are slower than diesel ferries
They must be recharged during the day
They carry more passengers than old ferries
They are built by the transit authority

why.vi: Một lần sạc chạy 40 km, và nhân viên sẽ sạc ở bến "during breaks", nên cần sạc giữa ngày.
why.en: One charge covers 40 km and crews recharge at the terminal during breaks, so recharging is needed during the day.

questions.trap: Bài không so sánh tốc độ hay sức chở với phà cũ.

passages.title: Letter from hotel
passages.text:
Lakeview Hotel
15 Shore Drive

June 12

Ms. Rita Alvarez
310 Pine Street

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

Thank you for your letter of June 3 regarding your recent stay. I am sorry that the air conditioning in Room 412 did not work during your visit. Our engineers have since repaired the unit.

As a gesture of goodwill, I have credited your account with the cost of one night ($140). I have also enclosed a voucher for a free breakfast for two, valid until December 31.

I hope to welcome you back soon.

Sincerely,
Martin Osei
General Manager

questions.q: Why did Mr. Osei write the letter?

why.vi: Ông xin lỗi vì máy lạnh phòng 412 không hoạt động.
why.en: He apologizes for the air conditioning that did not work.

questions.q: What has been credited to Ms. Alvarez's account?

why.vi: "credited your account with the cost of one night ($140)".
why.en: The letter says one night, $140, has been credited.

questions.trap: Bữa sáng miễn phí là phiếu đính kèm, không phải khoản ghi có vào tài khoản.

questions.q: The word "valid" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to

why.vi: "Valid until December 31": phiếu dùng được đến hết ngày đó.
why.en: A voucher that is valid until a date can be used until that date.

passages.title: Visitor badge procedure
passages.text:
MEMO
To: All employees
From: Security Office
Date: June 4
Re: New visitor badge procedure

Effective June 16, all visitors must be registered at the front desk before entering the building. [1] Employees expecting visitors should send the guest's name and arrival time to the Security Office by 4:00 P.M. on the previous day. [2] Visitors will be given a color-coded badge showing the floor they are allowed to visit. [3] Badges must be returned to the front desk when the visitor leaves. [4]

Employees who do not follow this procedure may lose the right to host visitors. Questions should be directed to Helen Ito at extension 318.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To announce a security guard's retirement
To describe a new visitor procedure

why.vi: Tiêu đề: "New visitor badge procedure".
why.en: The subject line announces a new visitor badge procedure.

questions.q: What should employees do by 4:00 P.M. on the day before a visit?
options: Meet the visitor at the front desk
Send the visitor's details to Security

why.vi: "send the guest's name and arrival time to the Security Office by 4:00 P.M."
why.en: Employees must send the guest's name and arrival time to Security.

questions.q: What is NOT required of visitors?

why.vi: Bản ghi nhớ không đề cập đến giấy tờ tùy thân có ảnh.
why.en: Photo identification is not mentioned anywhere in the memo.

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"This allows the front desk to prepare badges in advance."

why.vi: "This" chỉ việc gửi trước tên và giờ đến ở câu liền trước, nên câu đứng tại [2].
why.en: "This" refers to sending the guest's details the day before, so the sentence belongs at [2].

questions.trap: Ở [3] hoặc [4], "This" sẽ chỉ huy hiệu hoặc việc trả huy hiệu, không hợp nghĩa chuẩn bị trước.

passages.title: Lakeside Conference Center
passages.text:
Lakeside Conference Center | Room Rental

Cypress Room: up to 20 people, $120 per hour
Maple Hall: up to 60 people, $250 per hour
Grand Ballroom: up to 200 people, $600 per hour

Minimum rental: two hours. Wi-Fi, a projector, and a whiteboard are included at no extra charge.

Catering is available through Table & Fork. Orders for 30 or more guests must be placed at least five days in advance.

Cancellations: free up to 14 days before the event; 50 percent of the rental fee from 7 to 13 days before; no refund within 6 days.

Book online and receive 5 percent off the rental fee.

questions.q: What is included in the rental price?

why.vi: "Wi-Fi, a projector, and a whiteboard are included at no extra charge."
why.en: Wi-Fi, a projector, and a whiteboard are included.

questions.q: How much would a three-hour meeting for 45 people cost in the cheapest suitable room, booked online?

why.vi: 45 người cần Maple Hall: 3 x $250 = $750; đặt trực tuyến giảm 5% còn $712.50.
why.en: Maple Hall costs 3 x $250 = $750, and 5 percent off for online booking gives $712.50.

questions.trap: Cypress Room chỉ chứa 20 người; $750 là chưa trừ giảm giá 5%.

questions.q: What will happen if a customer cancels 10 days before the event?
options: The customer will pay half of the rental fee
The customer will pay the full fee
The customer must rebook within a week

why.vi: 10 ngày nằm trong khoảng 7 đến 13 ngày, bị tính 50% phí thuê.
why.en: Ten days falls between 7 and 13 days, so 50 percent of the fee is charged.

questions.q: What is suggested about catering for large groups?
options: It is only for the Grand Ballroom
It is included in room prices
It needs to be arranged early

why.vi: Đơn từ 30 khách trở lên phải đặt trước ít nhất năm ngày.
why.en: Orders for 30 or more guests must be placed at least five days ahead.

passages.title: Warehouse messages
passages.text:
Abel Torres (1:02 P.M.): Has anyone seen the pallet for Customer 8812? It's not at Dock 3.
Mia Chen (1:04 P.M.): I moved it to Dock 5 this morning. Dock 3 was blocked by the repair crew.

passages.title: Library extends hours
passages.text:
WESTBROOK (July 8) - Westbrook Public Library will extend its evening hours starting August 1, after a survey in which 62 percent of residents asked for later opening times. The library will now close at 9:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday instead of 7:00 P.M. Friday and Saturday hours remain 10:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M.

The change will be paid for by a donation from the Westbrook Business Association, which covers costs for one year. Two part-time clerks will be hired and staffing will be adjusted. "Many people work until 6:00 and could never visit," said librarian Fiona Walsh. A review next July will decide whether the longer hours continue.

story.speaker: NARRATOR
story.en: The reef. A garden of white light, thousands of tiny Turritopsis, glowing like a field of stars.
story.vi: Rạn san hô. Khu vườn ánh sáng trắng, hàng nghìn con Turritopsis nhỏ, sáng như một cánh đồng sao.

story.speaker: BAO
story.en: Stop, Huy! Put your hands up! Do you know how much this reef is worth?
story.vi: Dừng lại, Huy! Giơ tay lên! Em có biết rạn này đáng giá bao nhiêu không?

story.speaker: HUY
story.en: It is worth more than anything you can buy. And it is not yours, and it is not mine.
story.vi: Nó đáng giá hơn mọi thứ anh mua được. Và nó không phải của anh, cũng không phải của em.

story.speaker: NARRATOR
story.en: The tiny jellyfish rise around Bảo and the ship's lights go out. The Captain falls silent, and the sea takes him back to his boat.
story.vi: Những chú sứa nhỏ bay lên quanh Bảo và đèn tàu tắt. Thuyền trưởng im bặt, và biển đưa ông trở lại thuyền.

story.speaker: M
story.en: Huy. Can you hear me? Not through the radio. Not through the water. Me.
story.vi: Huy. Em nghe thấy anh không? Không qua radio. Không qua nước. Là anh.

story.speaker: HUY
story.en: M.! You are real! Where are you? I have looked for you every single night!
story.vi: M.! Anh là thật! Anh ở đâu? Em tìm anh mỗi đêm!

story.speaker: M
story.en: I was never lost, bé iu. You were. Every time your oxygen ended, you reset, like these little ones. And I kept sending my voice to the sea.
story.vi: Anh chưa bao giờ lạc, bé iu. Là em. Mỗi lần hết oxy, em reset, giống những chú sứa nhỏ này. Và anh cứ gửi giọng mình ra biển.

story.speaker: NOVA
story.en: Every signal you decoded was his message from the surface. Every English word you understood brought you one step closer. I am only the radio, Huy.
story.vi: Mọi tín hiệu em giải mã là tin nhắn của anh ấy từ mặt nước. Mỗi từ tiếng Anh em hiểu đưa em gần hơn một bước. Tôi chỉ là radio thôi, Huy.

story.speaker: BESUA
story.en: Huy giỏi quó. Em hong khóc đâu, hihi, em chỉ bị nước vô mắt thôi. Nè, Huy, nhìn lên đi.
story.vi: Huy giỏi quá. Em không khóc đâu, hihi, em chỉ bị nước vào mắt thôi. Nè, Huy, nhìn lên đi.

story.speaker: NARRATOR
story.en: Above him, the water turns from black to blue to gold. Huy kicks up, up, up, toward a warm light.
story.vi: Phía trên, nước chuyển từ đen sang xanh rồi vàng. Huy đạp nước lên, lên, lên, về phía ánh sáng ấm.

story.speaker: M
story.en: Huy, wherever you drift, my light stays on. Even in the deepest dark, follow my voice and wake up, bé iu.
story.vi: Huy, dù em trôi đến đâu, đèn của anh vẫn sáng. Kể cả trong bóng tối sâu nhất, hãy theo giọng anh và tỉnh dậy, bé iu.

story.speaker: NARRATOR
story.en: Huy opens his eyes. The café tanks hum softly. His phone glows on the table: "Did you eat yet? I am here. Good morning, bé iu." Huy smiles, wipes his face, and types: "Dọ. I love you a trillion."
story.vi: Huy mở mắt. Hồ sứa trong quán rì rầm. Điện thoại sáng trên bàn: "Ăn cơm chưa? Huy ở đây. Chào buổi sáng, bé iu." Huy mỉm cười, lau mặt, và nhắn: "Dọ. Em yêu anh một nghìn tỷ."

letter.vi: Bé iu, anh nói câu này lâu lắm rồi: "Huy, wherever you drift, my light stays on. Even in the deepest dark, follow my voice and wake up, bé IU." Bé đã nghe được hết bằng tiếng Anh rồi nè. Mai thi thật, ăn sáng đủ, ngủ sớm. Anh tin bé.
letter.en: My love, I have wanted to say this for so long: "Huy, wherever you drift, my light stays on. Even in the deepest dark, follow my voice and wake up, bé IU." You understood every word in English. Before the real test: eat breakfast, sleep early. I believe in you.

Huy, hồi đầu Huy nghe tiếng Anh như nghe sóng ù ù. Giờ Huy nghe ra từng chữ rồi nè. Dọ!
